findings.lineage: The v39-to-v40 successor sweep rewrites the frozen v39 predecessor into v40 at three live custody sites.
findings.finding: authorityClaim says leftover-join.v40 of G21 remasures leftover-join.v40 of G21, making the candidate its own predecessor. basedOn.d357.role says D-357 recorded leftover-join.v40 of G21, although D-357 recorded frozen leftover-join.v39 of G21. remeasurementClause then names leftover-join.v40 twice in its unmoved-input guard and omits leftover-join.v39 from that guard. The same subject says the opposite in basedOn.leftoverJoinV39.role, registerRowNote, purpose, findingDisposition.claudeV33M1, and findingDisposition.claudeV26M1: v39 is the D-357 current recorded predecessor, authorityClaim is supposed to remasure v39, and the guard is supposed to protect v39.
findings.evidence: Live COORD heading D-357 is 'Record leftover-join.v39 of G21 as G21 leftover remasurement'; commit 9c9275f92a4d57f1a86efdd6d67bdda7da6d1f66 has the same subject; frozen v39 reproduces at f1bb85c2d8af39089ddfb66a2dc131dc60dd42852f556b0c18c6efa7b5382c01. D-358 explicitly leaves v39 current for a later successor to remasure. The v39-to-v40 scalar delta shows the predecessor occurrence in authorityClaim and the first predecessor guard occurrence in remeasurementClause were both advanced to v40, while the intended subject occurrence at the end of the guard was also advanced to v40. findingDisposition.claudeV33M1 and findingDisposition.claudeV26M1 describe the intended v39 values but do not match their live target fields.
findings.why: A recordable successor must identify the frozen current measurement it succeeds and must not attribute its own recording to an earlier decision. The false D-357 attribution rewrites recorded lineage; the self-remasurement erases the successor edge; and the missing v39 motion guard makes the candidate's remeasurement rule under-protect its cited current predecessor.
findings.requiredCorrection: In authorityClaim, make v40 remasure frozen leftover-join.v39 of G21, without calling v39 a golden. In basedOn.d357.role, restore the recorded subject to leftover-join.v39 of G21. In remeasurementClause, guard leftover-join.v39 of G21 as the predecessor and leftover-join.v40 of G21 as the subject, each once. Keep frozen v38 Findings landing at v39 and do not edit any frozen predecessor. Make the two finding-disposition descriptions agree with their corrected target fields.

findings.lineage: The D-357 currency sweep leaves frozen v35 labelled current after v39 was adopted.
findings.finding: findingDisposition.claudeV29M1 says leftover-join.v35 of G21 'stays current until a recordable successor is adopted', even though leftover-join.v39 of G21 was adopted at D-357. findingDisposition.codexV29MustFix likewise says current-remasurement recitals advance to v35 at D-355. These are live present-tense finding dispositions, not quotations scoped to the pre-D-357 repository state, and they contradict basedOn.leftoverJoinV35.role, which correctly says v35 is historical after D-357, as well as every primary currency field naming v39 current.
findings.evidence: Live COORD D-357 records v39; frozen v39 and both frozen v39 Stage A reviews reproduce; basedOn.leftoverJoinV39.role, registerRowNote, purpose, authorityClaim's currency sentence, remeasurementClause's currency sentence, and the historical predecessor roles all name v39 as the sole current recorded G21 leftover remasurement until a successor is adopted. A whole-subject census of strings combining v35 with current standing isolates the two positive stale finding-disposition claims; other v35/current occurrences either name v39 as current, mark v35 historical, or prohibit v35 from being current after succession.
findings.why: The prompt expressly fixes v35 as historical after D-357 and attacks any current label. Carried finding dispositions remain claims about what landed; they cannot preserve a superseded current-state assertion after the repository records a successor.
findings.requiredCorrection: Advance both finding dispositions to the live D-357 standing: v35 remains recorded at D-355 but is historical after D-357, and v39 is current until a recordable successor is adopted. Preserve the frozen v34 Findings landing at v35 and invent no finding identifier.

Subject identity, mode, strict JSON validity, duplicate-key freedom, live HEAD, file 08, COORD, required-now 28, D-358 last-heading custody, all 205 recorded-input files, all 178 structured path/digest occurrences, all 27 decision commit pins, frozen landing custody, and the D-358 four-copy authoring reproduce.
